fine_lines.title: say vs tell
fine_lines.explanation_ar: say نستخدمه للكلام نفسه ولا يحتاج شخصاً بعده مباشرة، و tell يحتاج شخصاً بعده: tell me, tell him.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Say" is about the words; it does not need a person after it. "Tell" needs a person: tell me.

fine_lines.title: look vs see
fine_lines.explanation_ar: see تعني أن ترى بعينك بدون قصد، و look تعني أن توجه نظرك عمداً، وتأتي بعدها at.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "See" happens naturally with your eyes. "Look (at)" means you choose to turn your eyes to something.

examples.sentence: I can see the sea from here.

fine_lines.title: speak vs talk
fine_lines.explanation_ar: speak أكثر رسمية وتُستخدم مع اللغات (speak English)، و talk للحديث العادي بين الناس (talk to a friend).
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Speak" is more formal and used for languages. "Talk" is for normal conversation.

fine_lines.title: bring vs take
fine_lines.explanation_ar: bring تعني تحضر الشيء إلى المكان الذي أنت فيه أو المتكلم فيه، و take تعني تأخذه بعيداً إلى مكان آخر.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Bring" is towards the speaker. "Take" is away from the speaker.

examples.sentence: Take this letter to the office.

fine_lines.title: hear vs listen
fine_lines.explanation_ar: hear تعني أن يصل الصوت إلى أذنك، و listen (to) تعني أن تنتبه للصوت عمداً.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Hear" means sound reaches your ears. "Listen (to)" means you pay attention.

grammar.title: Present simple with he / she / it
grammar.explanation_ar: في المضارع البسيط نضيف s للفعل مع he و she و it: she lives, he drives. إذا انتهى الفعل بـ y بعد حرف ساكن تصبح ies: study → studies. وإذا انتهى بـ s, sh, ch, o نضيف es: go → goes.
grammar.explanation_en: In the present simple, add -s to the verb after he, she, it: she lives. Consonant + y → ies (studies). After s, sh, ch, o add -es (goes, watches).

grammar.title: Irregular past forms
grammar.explanation_ar: كثير من الأفعال الشائعة ماضيها غير منتظم ولا يأخذ ed، ويجب حفظه: go → went، see → saw، take → took، give → gave، buy → bought، understand → understood.
grammar.explanation_en: Many common verbs have an irregular past (no -ed). Learn them: go → went, see → saw, give → gave, buy → bought, understand → understood.
examples: She gave us a nice vase.

grammar.title: Regular past with -ed
grammar.explanation_ar: الأفعال المنتظمة نضيف لها ed في الماضي: visit → visited، return → returned. إذا انتهى الفعل بـ e نضيف d فقط: increase → increased.
grammar.explanation_en: Regular verbs add -ed in the past: visit → visited. If the verb ends in e, add only -d: increase → increased.

grammar.title: Verbs followed by -ing or to
grammar.explanation_ar: بعض الأفعال يأتي بعدها فعل بصيغة ing مثل love, like, mind: He loves swimming. وبعضها يأتي بعده to + فعل مثل want, need, expect, decide: I want to go.
grammar.explanation_en: Some verbs are followed by -ing (love, like, mind): He loves swimming. Others take to + verb (want, need, expect, decide): I want to go.
examples: He didn't expect to see me.

questions.question: What is the past of "buy"?
questions.explanation_ar: الماضي من buy هو bought. أما brought فهي ماضي bring.
questions.explanation_en: The past of "buy" is "bought". "Brought" is the past of "bring".

questions.question: Plants need water to ___.

questions.explanation_en: After "to" we use the base form of the verb.
